feeding_claim.verbatim: We only offer meat that is finished when fresh, green grass is available.

availability.note: The farm says its processor is booked out over a year and it may have to stop selling beef; buyers are asked to get on the list.

notes: Beefmaster and Beefmaster or Angus cross cattle sold by hanging weight; order by email or text (479-719-0102). Price sheet PDF (uploaded 2019) says beef is finished only when green grass is available and that a protein supplement is fed in drought and winter; homepage title says grass fed, grass finished; Verifier to judge whether grass-finished holds. Delivery at a per-mile fee, no towns named; the area wording comes from the homepage title.
